opportunities.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
opportunities.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. [Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast).

opportunities.title: Render blocking requests
opportunities.description: Requests are blocking the page's initial render, which may delay LCP. [Deferring or inlining](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/render-blocking) can move these network requests out of the critical path.

opportunities.title: Displays images with incorrect aspect ratio
opportunities.description: Image display dimensions should match natural aspect ratio. [Learn more about image aspect ratio](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/image-aspect-ratio/).

opportunities.title: `[aria-*]` attributes do not match their roles
opportunities.description: Each ARIA `role` supports a specific subset of `aria-*` attributes. Mismatching these invalidates the `aria-*` attributes. [Learn how to match ARIA attributes to their roles](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/aria-allowed-attr).

opportunities.title: Document does not have a valid `rel=canonical`
opportunities.description: Canonical links suggest which URL to show in search results. [Learn more about canonical links](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/canonical/).

opportunities.title: Reduce unused CSS
opportunities.description: Reduce unused rules from stylesheets and defer CSS not used for above-the-fold content to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused CSS](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-css-rules/).

opportunities.title: Elements with an ARIA `[role]` that require children to contain a specific `[role]` are missing some or all of those required children.
opportunities.description: Some ARIA parent roles must contain specific child roles to perform their intended accessibility functions. [Learn more about roles and required children elements](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/aria-required-children).

opportunities.title: Touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing.
opportunities.description: Touch targets with sufficient size and spacing help users who may have difficulty targeting small controls to activate the targets. [Learn more about touch targets](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/target-size).
